title: Design System: Jayce Yap Zi Wen

headline.purpose: Section headings, with local editorial size adjustments.

body.purpose: 15px global baseline; explanatory paragraphs use the 14px explanation role.

label.purpose: Form labels; controls, consent, validation, and supporting notes generally use the same 12px size.

explanation.purpose: Readable 14px supporting paragraphs, coverage list items, and FAQ questions.

field.purpose: 16px text entry; date and time fields are 14px on larger screens and 16px on mobile.

sculpture-display.purpose: Local default hero headline; retains the original portrait display role separately.

sculpture-display-compact.purpose: Local 88px heading step at maximum width 1100px.

sculpture-display-tablet.purpose: Local 72px heading step at maximum width 800px.

sculpture-display-mobile.purpose: Local fluid heading at maximum width 600px, with 0.86 line height.

sculpture-subheading.purpose: Fluid desktop serif subheading, becoming 25px at tablet and mobile widths.

sculpture-chapter-title.purpose: Local 26px topic heading; 24px on tablet and 26px on mobile.

hero-switch.purpose: Local 11px switch label, reduced to 10px at tablet and mobile widths.

chapters-display.purpose: Third-hero main heading; 66px at 1000px and clamp(61px,12vw,78px) at 700px.

chapters-title.purpose: Third-hero story heading; 36px at 1000px and 39px at 700px.

chapters-focus.purpose: 23px italic serif takeaway within the active life chapter.

protection-word.purpose: 37px coverage-card title, reduced to 30px at tablet and mobile widths.

shadows.name: floating-contact
shadows.purpose: Floating contact action, shown only after the hero leaves the viewport.

motion.name: expressive-ease
motion.purpose: Hero entrance, protection layer transforms, and journal image scale.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Primary button background, press transform, and shadow.

motion.name: content-entrance
motion.purpose: Article, FAQ, and coverage content entrance.

motion.name: layer-transform
motion.purpose: Flat two-dimensional four-card coverage selection with persistent items and deterministic rank-based stacking; no hover transforms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion override; smooth scrolling also stops.

motion.name: article-scroll
motion.purpose: Opening an article focuses and scrolls to its detail panel; closing restores focus and scroll to its originating card.

motion.name: hero-version-entrance
motion.purpose: Entrance for the newly mounted Sculpture or Portrait hero; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: shield-ready
motion.value: canvas opacity 600ms ease; fallback opacity 300ms ease
motion.purpose: Crossfade from an immediate three-icon fallback to the ready shield canvas, disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: shield-render-budget
motion.value: Display animation cadence; maximum device pixel ratio 1.5; six draw calls per frame
motion.purpose: Renderer loads within 120px of the viewport, prepares shaders asynchronously with a 128px environment map, suspends looping when paused, offscreen, document-hidden, reduced-motion, or context-lost, rebuilds lighting after context restoration, and disposes when another hero mounts.

motion.name: shield-selection-and-separation
motion.value: pose interpolation factor 0.13; instant while motion disabled
motion.purpose: A 0-100% slider, initially 65%, separates the three extruded shields; canvas raycasting and HTML topic buttons share the same selected topic.

motion.name: shield-pointer-response
motion.purpose: Restrained assembly response while animation is enabled; direct shield selection remains available when motion is disabled.

motion.name: chapter-unfold
motion.purpose: Selected life chapter story entrance, disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: chapter-timeline
motion.purpose: Apricot selected-rule expansion; disabled under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
A warm editorial portrait feature brings a person, clear explanations, and a considered invitation into the same visual world.
Expressive serif headings, ivory surfaces, and restrained wine accents create a composed, personal atmosphere.

The layout has generous section spacing and compact practical details.
Photography, the layered shields, and the protection card deck provide the strongest visual depth, while interface controls remain precise and legible.
This document records the implemented system in `src/tokens.css` and `src/styles.css`, plus the scoped hero extension in `src/HeroExperience.tsx`, `src/hero-experience.css`, `src/shield-scene.ts`, `src/LifeChapters.tsx`, and `src/life-chapters.css`.
It does not imply owner approval of the generated portrait or drafted personal statements.

The default opening presents three distinct shield layers under the thesis "Life is connected."
An onsite Sculpture / Portrait / Life chapters switch offers an interactive shield, the preserved editorial portrait, and a wine-colored chapter narrative.
This user-requested extension retains the established palette and type pairing while adding local hero type sizes and a rounded presentation switch.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and wine accents.
Expressive serif headings paired with quiet sans-serif detail.
Fine dividing rules and predominantly square controls.
Sculptural protection layers and an asymmetric portrait crop.
Three switchable hero presentations with contextual protection and life-stage choices.
Purposeful motion with a complete reduced-motion override.

rules.name: The Wine Signal Rule
rules.body: Use wine consistently for action, emphasis, selection, and focus so those states read as one family.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for expressive headings and the sans serif for practical reading and interaction.

rules.name: The Sculptural Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary editorial content flat and use the most visible depth to clarify the protection layers.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, wine, and olive-charcoal relationship.
Do pair expressive serif headings with clear sans-serif controls.
Do keep selected states and keyboard focus visibly tied to wine.
Do preserve the square control language and reserve curves for the established signature shapes.
Do maintain stacked mobile layouts and the reduced-motion override.
Do keep the generated portrait disclosure readable until an approved portrait replaces it.
Do keep sculpture typography, the Life chapters palette, and rounded switch tokens scoped to the switchable hero.
Do keep topic explanations and consultation actions usable independently of WebGL.
donts: Don't apply rounded cards or heavy shadows to ordinary editorial content.
Don't use the serif for form labels or dense practical instructions.
Don't make essential information depend on hover or animation.
Don't style an appointment request as a confirmed appointment.
Don't apply the hero switch's rounded options to existing square form controls.
Don't continue sculpture animation while paused, offscreen, hidden, or under reduced motion.
Don't reintroduce perspective planes or hover transforms into the four-card coverage deck.
